settings.name: Code
settings.description: Paths to the interpreters that run code lessons.

pythonPath.label: Python interpreter
pythonPath.hint: Path to the executable file (for example, /usr/bin/python3). Python lessons cannot run without it.

javascriptPath.label: JavaScript interpreter
javascriptPath.hint: Path to the Node.js executable file (for example, /usr/bin/node). JavaScript lessons cannot run without it.
